setup.title: LibreLink vs LibreLinkUp, which account does Dulce use?
setup.description: Dulce signs in with your LibreLinkUp account, not LibreLink. Here's the difference, and how to turn on sharing so your readings reach Dulce.

hero.headline: LibreLink vs LibreLinkUp: which one does Dulce use?
hero.subheadline: They look almost the same, but they are two different apps with two different logins. Dulce connects to LibreLinkUp, the app that receives readings shared with you. This page shows you exactly how to set it up.

scan.title: LibreLink
scan.body: The app you install to scan your FreeStyle Libre sensor and see your own readings. Dulce cannot sign in with this account.

share.title: LibreLinkUp
share.body: The companion app that receives readings shared with you, normally used by family. This is the account Dulce needs.

step1.title: Install LibreLinkUp
step1.body: Download LibreLinkUp from the App Store or Google Play and create an account with your email. Keep this email and password, you'll use them in Dulce.

step2.title: Open LibreLink and go to Connected Apps
step2.body: In the LibreLink app you scan with, open the menu and find the sharing or “Connected Apps / LinkUp” section.

step3.title: Invite your LibreLinkUp email
step3.body: Add the same email address you just registered in LibreLinkUp as a connection, then accept the invitation inside LibreLinkUp.

step4.title: Sign in to Dulce
step4.body: Open Dulce and enter your LibreLinkUp email and password. Your glucose appears within a few seconds.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Why doesn't my LibreLink login work in Dulce?
faq.a1: Because LibreLink and LibreLinkUp are separate apps with separate accounts. Dulce uses LibreLinkUp. If your login is rejected, you are almost certainly typing your LibreLink details, create a LibreLinkUp account and use that instead.
faq.q2: I signed in but Dulce shows no data. What's wrong?
faq.a2: Your LibreLinkUp login worked, but nothing is being shared with it yet. Open the LibreLink app you scan with, go to Connected Apps, and invite your LibreLinkUp email. Accept the invitation, then Dulce will start receiving readings.
faq.a3: No. Dulce is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Abbott. FreeStyle Libre, LibreLink and LibreLinkUp are trademarks of Abbott, used here only to describe how to connect.

llustatus.title: Is LibreLinkUp down? Live status
llustatus.description: Is LibreLinkUp down? Live status measured every minute: the last 24 hours, response time, affected regions and what to do during an outage.

lead.operational: Our checks are getting readings from LibreLinkUp as usual. If you don't see new readings, the problem is most likely on the sensor phone.
lead.degraded: Some requests to LibreLinkUp are failing or slow. Readings may arrive late or not at all for a while.
lead.down: Most requests to LibreLinkUp are failing. Followers and apps that read LibreLinkUp, Dulce included, won't get new readings until it recovers.
lead.unknown: There were too few checks in the last few minutes to say. Check again in a moment.

how.title: How this works
how.body: Dulce's servers read LibreLinkUp every minute for the people who use Dulce. We count how many of those requests succeed and how long they take, across all regions. A wrong password or an expired login for one person doesn't count as a failure; only errors from LibreLinkUp itself do. We don't store anyone's glucose for this page.

todo.title: What to do if LibreLinkUp is down
items: Your sensor keeps working. Read your glucose directly in the Libre app on your phone (LibreLink or Libre 3).
Keep the Libre app's own alarms on: they don't depend on LibreLinkUp.
Let your followers know: they won't see new readings until it's back.
When LibreLinkUp recovers, the chart fills in with the missing readings.

upButNoData.title: LibreLinkUp is up but you see no data?
upButNoData.body: Then the problem is almost always on the phone of the person wearing the sensor: no internet, the Libre app closed by the system, or sharing switched off. Our troubleshooting guide covers every cause.
upButNoData.link: LibreLinkUp not working: step by step

faq.a: This page shows LibreLinkUp's live status, measured every minute from Dulce's servers: working, having problems or down, with the last 24 hours.

faq.q: Does Dulce work when LibreLinkUp is down?
faq.a: No. Dulce reads your readings through LibreLinkUp, so when LibreLinkUp is down Dulce gets nothing new either. Your sensor and the Libre app keep working.

faq.q: Is this an official Abbott status page?
faq.a: No. Dulce is independent and not affiliated with Abbott. These are our own measurements; Abbott may report differently for your region.

llustatus.disclaimer: Dulce is an independent app, not affiliated with Abbott. FreeStyle Libre, LibreLink and LibreLinkUp are trademarks of Abbott. Status is measured by Dulce and may not reflect every region or account.
